method: Read existing active board, board-subject, and blueprint records. Counted the runtime-valid, content-deduplicated pool with QuestionPoolFilter and a single QuestionEligibilityIndex. Civil Service pools are reported separately by registered level. LET's count is broad because exact availability depends on the selected registered level/specialization.

configuration_mapping_notes: Runtime execution now consumes the existing sourced board blueprint and exact taxonomy domain identities for CE, ME, REE, and Architecture.
Architecture's official 30% Area A is preserved as a combined allocation, then split 50/50 over the two mapped sections as an internal selection rule; no official subarea weights are asserted.

Architecture Area B's configured question pool is Utilities and Construction only and does not separately cover every structural-conceptualization/materials topic in the official area title; this is a content-depth caveat, not an eligibility change.

final_subject_identity_repair.issue: A final Full Doctor exposed canonical subject identity mismatch for REE study-library routing and Architecture cross-board allocation.
final_subject_identity_repair.repair: Prefer explicit configured section subject_id for runtime allocation and eligibility resolution; retain legacy section id fallback.

preserved_behavior.deterministic_rounding: Existing RuntimeAllocationService and BlueprintDistributionAllocator contracts are retained and regression-tested.
preserved_behavior.explicit_random_seed_api: None exists in QuizSpecification or the selection request path. Existing random selection behavior remains; adaptive ranking is deterministic for the realized eligible pool and difficulty slot counts.
